notes.title: Update R4!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

We have just released update R4 for Lusitania!

[h1]Additions/changes:[/h1]

-We have added the ability to walk on water! This will now allow you to walk around the ship while it's sinking instead of going through it

-We added a new daytime explore mode

-We added a new horn sound when the Lusitania abandons ship. This new sound is more historically accurate then the previous one

-Added new engine sounds

-Added new creaking sounds when the ship begins to sink faster

-Reduced second explosion sound and background sea audio

-The main menu camera position has been changed

We have also changed the game's name to Lusitania: The Experience.

If you are enjoying the game, remember to leave a review! It helps alot!

[b]Interactive Gaming Studios[/b]

notes.title: Update R3!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We have just released our release 3 (R3) update for Lusitania! The details are below.

[h1]Fixes:    [/h1]

-The propellers now stop rotating when the ship is going out of the water. Before they kept rotating

-The fourth funnel no longer has smoke coming out of it (for accuracy purposes)

-The stern of the ship is now fixed. There was an area near the stairs where you fell through the ship.

[h1]Interactive Gaming Studios    [/h1]

notes.title: Update R2!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We have just uploaded our release 2 update! The additions/changes are detailed below.

[h1]Additions/Changes    [/h1]

-We have added 2 horn blasts to indicate the Lusitania is abandoning ship

-We have added white mist when the ship starts to interact with the water (this is for the front and back)

-The ship now fully sinks (before it didn't go right under)

-The smoke stacks do not keep going while in the water

-We have added bubbles behind the propellers to make it look more realistic

-We removed some things that could cause you to get stuck in some places

[h1]Interactive Gaming Studios    [/h1]

notes.title: Update R1!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We have just uploaded our release 1 update! The changes are below.

[h1]Additions/changes    [/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a popup which tells you when the torpedo is going to hit so its easier to see when it is coming to the ship

[*]Reduced the background sounds in the first person experience so its easier to hear the torpedo

[*]Added a new explosion sound effect which occurs a little bit after the torpedo has hit (due to the boiler rooms etc)

[*]We added extra information on the main menu

[*]We made the pause menu easier to navigate in the first person experience

If you are enjoying the Lusitania, please leave a review! It is greatly appreciated.

[h1]Interactive Gaming Studios    [/h1]

[/list]
